With no organization source stated, the service asks ADR-0131 D9's predicate itself, through the engine it holds, by the same `resolveGuestOrganization` call the plugin makes. Proxy ruling under the maintainer's delegation quoted above (carried into this project by its owner's standing rule 「卡线程报 needs_decision 时，另开 fable 裁决线程，有把握就裁并把裁决落在 GitHub 上，没把握才给 Bill 发决策卡」), by the review thread's session `session_0157eFnRDZbbD82agNfmyW9r` ([project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuScJnaALKTmkF3J3WYxnpEj)), on the `domain:services` seat 1 card thread's needs_decision fork (claim `6354964172`, session `session_014FFTcf6msoLbXiD6BR7wHW`, branch `claude/project-thread-c4vx2u` at `3c27c0a`, one file changed, no PR yet). Marker: `auto-adjudicated`. ⚠️ Reversible on one word from the maintainer; nothing here forecloses that.

## The question

The card (filed from PR #25226's contract review, record `6343868210` ③ 3b) wants a host that binds `SettingsService` with no organization source to 「derive from the bound engine, or refuse」, with the lean composition unchanged. The card thread measured the obstacle: the service holds the narrow `SettingsEngine` (`find` / `insert` / `update`, `settings-service.types.ts:122`), the plugin's own `wrapEngineAsSettingsEngine` forwards those three and nothing else (`settings-service-plugin.ts:893-920`), so the service cannot ask a registry whether `sys_organization` is registered — and ADR-0131 D9's predicate, asked through such an engine, reads a registry that cannot answer as 「registered」. The forks:

- **A** (the card thread's recommendation, on the branch) — with no source stated, the service asks D9 itself through the engine it holds, by the one call the plugin makes (`resolveGuestOrganization`), fail closed: an engine that exposes no registry is read as registering the organization object, so a self-binding host that means the lean composition states it (`bindEngine(…, { organization })` answering `no-organization-object`). No engine keeps the lean reading. Plugin-bound compositions (`os serve`, `os dev`) are unchanged.
- **B** — derive only when the engine exposes a registry; a registry-less engine keeps today's NULL reading. Not breaking; the repo's own wrapper shape, the one the card names, stays unfixed.
- **C** — with no source and an engine, refuse at bind. Loudest; every unstated self-binding host fails at startup, and the constructor path needs a new input.

## Governing text, read at `origin/main` `97967a9`

- ADR-0131 D9 and its note (ruling `6328987873` on #25133, letter A): 「The rule above applies where an organization can exist. When the composition registers no `sys_organization`, there is none to derive … the exception is deliberate」; 「the exception holds only for programmatic embedding and `--dev`」; not taken there: 「letter B, the engine refusing every organization-less write, which would withdraw this exception」. ADR-0131 D8: no layer has a NULL arm.
- `packages/core/src/security/system-write-organization.ts`, `resolveSystemWriteOrganization`, on its `organizationObjectRegistered` input: 「It is a required input, not a defaulted one: a caller that does not know the answer must not be handed the permissive reading by omission.」
- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:1235-1243`, `registryHoldsObject`: 「A registry that cannot answer is not an answer — `true`, so the read is issued and decides」; `:1276-1296`, `resolveGuestOrganization`: `organizationObjectRegistered = !!ql && typeof ql.find === 'function' && registryHoldsObject(ql, 'sys_organization')`, probe `tryFind(ql, 'sys_organization', {}, 2)`; `tryFind` `:351-440`: no engine answers `[]`, a thrown read answers `[]` only under `isMissingTableError(err, object)` and otherwise raises `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` (the 2026-08-30 loudness ruling quoted there).
- ADR-0138 D4 item 2, as `guest-organization.ts` and the `resolveGuestOrganization` docblock carry it: the guest step is bound to the engine's predicate, 「never a second spelling of it」.
- PR #25226 (`279fdcf469`, contract review PASS `6343868210`): the reach table — 「names none, composition registers no organization object (lean embedding; ruled kept) → `no-organization-object`」; its ③ 3b: 「`SettingsService.bindEngine` without an `organization` source reads as the lean composition (NULL rows) on any composition … Suggest the service derive from the bound engine when the source is unset, or refuse.」 Its ② records why that PR declared `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: `bindEngine` gained the optional `organization` input.
- `settings-service.ts:200-206` (the sentence this card retires): 「Unset — a service constructed directly — reads as a composition that registers no organization object: nothing names an organization to it.」 `index.ts:78`: a host that binds its own engine (「control-plane mocks, embedded runtimes」). In-repo constructors outside tests: one, the plugin (`settings-service-plugin.ts:212`), which always binds a source (`:344-345`). `SettingsServiceOptions` (`settings-service.types.ts:370-424`) takes `engine` and no `organization`.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉: 「具名不升级类(立即行动):恢复不变量」; 「既有门禁内部参数与盲区修复(加强,非削弱,非新增)」; 「契约收紧(严格 schema、publish 时响亮拒绝)优于消费端宽容(`??` 回退、静默容错)」; 「过渡也从紧 —— 创业阶段不渐进」; 「协议为基准:spec 与代码不一致默认改代码对齐」.

## Ruling: A

**Why not B.** B writes, as a third arm of the service, exactly the reading D9's predicate refuses to take by omission: 「registry invisible ⇒ lean」. For the one shape the card names (the repo's own wrapper, and every hand-written `SettingsEngine` a host must write because `IDataEngine.update` has another signature) B changes nothing, so neither half of the acceptance line — 「reads and writes the derived organization, or is refused」 — is met. It is the consumer-side tolerance the four axes rank last: a host on a `sys_organization` store keeps writing NULL rows until the driver's NOT NULL (7b-0) or the identity index refuses them, which is the #25226 shape again.

**Why not C.** The service cannot see the registry, so 「refuse at bind on a composition that registers `sys_organization`」 can only be spelled 「refuse every unstated bind that carries an engine」 — wider than the acceptance, since it refuses the host D9 could have served, and it discards the route the card names first. It also needs a new constructor input (`SettingsServiceOptions` has none), a widening beside a narrowing. The loudness C buys, A already has, and at the place ADR-0138 D4 item 3 puts the refusal: where the organization matters (the first tenant-rung read or write by a caller naming none), not at boot for a host that reads only global keys.

**Why A is inside the text, and this lane's to carry.** A restores the invariant (恢复不变量): D8's 「no NULL arm」 and D9's 「required input, not defaulted」 now hold on the self-binding path as #25226 made them hold on the plugin path. It aligns the consumer with the protocol's own predicate, one spelling (`resolveGuestOrganization`, the call the plugin already makes), no probe of the service's own. It is a narrowing with one revert: who may read shrinks (an unstated host on a `sys_organization` store stops reading NULL rows it can no longer write there), nothing widens, no gate changes, no capability moves, no registered contract entry is rewritten — the sentence retired is a `settings-service.ts` docblock from #25226 that the same PR's contract review flagged as the residual. The lean exception of the D9 note is kept, not withdrawn (A is not #25133's letter B): the plugin path, a service with no engine, a stated source, and an engine whose `registry.getObject` answers (the real `ObjectQL` exposes `get registry()`, `engine.ts:5261`) all keep NULL rows; what moves is one shape — a registry-less wrapper over a store with no `sys_organization` object, with nothing stated — and it moves to a loud answer, cured by one line. Precedent for a narrowing `!` PR under this delegation: `6345869077` on #25095.

Fixed here, so the dev opens no second decision:

1. **Route.** A as on `3c27c0a`: `organizationDecision()` answers the stated source first; no engine is the lean reading; otherwise `resolveGuestOrganization(this.engine, await this.tenancyPosture?.())`. ⛔ No second predicate, no registry sniffing arm (that is B), and no `catch` in the service that turns a thrown probe into the lean reading — the plugin path leaves that throw uncaught by design (`6343868210` ③ 3a).
2. **Surface.** No new public input: `SettingsServiceOptions` gains no `organization`, `bindEngine`'s extras are unchanged. The declaration a lean self-binding host makes is `bindEngine(engine, audit, { organization: async () => ({ kind: 'no-organization-object' }) })`, or an engine whose `registry.getObject` answers. Hence `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (unlike #25226, nothing is added to the accept set), `Metadata-protocol: none`, changeset `patch` for `@objectstack/service-settings` with the BREAKING banner (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3: a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch`), ADR-0087 marker expected `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — unverified, the gate decides.
3. **Changeset migration text.** FROM: a host that binds or constructs the service with an engine and states no organization source read and wrote `sys_setting` rows with no organization on every composition. TO: it reads and writes as the organization ADR-0131 D9 derives through that engine; over a store with no `sys_organization` object and an engine that exposes no registry, a caller naming none is `unowned` (tenant writes refused, reads from the global rung or default) or meets the predicate's loud read error. Who: only a host that binds the service itself — in this repo none in production; `os serve`, `os dev` and every plugin-bound composition are unchanged. The one-line fix for a lean host is the declaration in item 2. ⛔ No staged window, no dual reading (「过渡也从紧」).
4. **Tests.** Every service-settings test that modelled the lean composition through a registry-less engine with no source says so truthfully, one of two ways: the stated source at its bind (a shared constant is fine), or — where the test runs a real `ObjectQL` behind the wrapper — the real engine's `registry` forwarded on the wrapped engine, which is the composition's own fact and lets D9 answer `no-organization-object` itself. ⛔ Not a default inside the service, not a stub `getObject` with a canned answer, not a new constructor input. A test that models a `sys_organization` composition gives its mock a `sys_organization` row and asserts the derived organization. Measured by this ruling on `origin/main` `97967a9` with the branch's one file applied: 7 files / 45 tests red of 58 / 982 (baseline on `97967a9`: 58 / 982 green) — `settings-secret-rotation.test.ts` 15, `settings-user-rung-owner.pin.test.ts` 15, `settings-getmany.test.ts` 4, `sys-secret-orphan-report.test.ts` 4, `settings-global-rung.test.ts` 3, `settings-system-context.pin.test.ts` 2, `settings-user-reference.pin.test.ts` 2; the card thread's reading is confirmed. 22 of the 45 run a real `ObjectQL` behind the repo's wrapper and raise `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` from `tryFind` (the probe meets `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` for `sys_organization`, which `isMissingTableError` does not recognise); the rest run mocks whose probe answers `[]` and read `unowned` (defaults answer, tenant writes refused with the per-organization sentence). The four files outside the package that construct the service (`auth-plugin.test.ts:580,587`, `mail-test-recipient.pin.test.ts:84`, `capability-arg.config-parity.contract.test.ts:103`, `sms-test-recipient.pin.test.ts:59`) pass `{ env }` and bind no engine: unchanged, no edit.
5. **Pins** (the card's 「This is pinned」; service-settings, mock engine unless said): (a) a self-binding host, registry-less wrapper over a store holding one `sys_organization` row, no source, caller names none, no posture or `single`: tenant and user rung read and write `own(that organization)`; (b) the same host over a store with no `sys_organization` object, no source: loud — with a mock whose probe answers `[]`, `unowned` (the tenant write refused with the existing per-organization sentence, the read answering the global rung or default); behind a real `ObjectQL` with no such object, `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` from `tryFind` (measured here: the engine's `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` is not a missing-table code) — pinned as measured, ⛔ not converted in the service and ⛔ `isMissingTableError` not widened (the 2026-08-30 ruling quoted beside it); (c) a stated lean source: NULL rows, unchanged; (d) no engine: unchanged; (e) the existing plugin pins (`settings-organization-reach.pin.test.ts`, `settings-organization-isolation.pin.test.ts`) keep their assertions; (f) ablation — the engine branch of `organizationDecision` removed — (a) is red.
6. **Docs.** The docblocks on the branch stand; `index.ts:78`'s host paragraph gains the declaration line and names the symptom of omitting it (a tenant-rung read or write by a caller naming none that is refused as organization-less, or that raises `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` naming `sys_organization`); the changeset carries the same two sentences. ⛔ No `docs/adr/**` edit: the D9 note already draws the exception's boundary and nothing here contradicts it. A `content/docs` page only if the docs-drift check names one (unverified).
7. **External hosts.** Cloud control-plane mocks and embedded runtimes are downstream of the published package; the changeset's FROM / TO and one-line fix are the hand-off. This project files no cloud card (`references/cross-repo-coordination.md`: a single-lane repo this project cannot reach; splitting by repo is the director's call) — the card thread's report lists the hand-off under `out_of_scope_findings` so the director can route one pointer if wanted.
8. **Review.** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` from an isolated reviewer before the queue (narrowing face, as #25226), the full dogfood battery on the final head (`!` title), R1–R4 as #25226's seat check measured them (a walled boot measured, or the compensating `main` battery named). Hand-back to `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) for ACCEPT.
9. **Premises, falsifiable, re-verified on the branch's base before the test migration is written** (all read true by this ruling at `97967a9`): P1 `registryHoldsObject` answers `true` when `registry.getObject` is not a function (core `:1235-1243`); P2 `SettingsEngine` and `wrapEngineAsSettingsEngine` expose no registry and forward `find` verbatim; P3 the plugin binds a source on every engine bind (`:344-345`); P4 the plugin is the only non-test constructor in the repo. If one fails, stop and report the fork; ⛔ do not fall back to B, and do not add the constructor input (C).

### Why A, on the four axes (business standpoint)

- **① Long-term soundness (weight ≥50%).** Two years out the platform has one answer to 「which organization does a caller naming none act in?」: D9's predicate, asked once per layer through the engine that layer holds, with the lean composition a thing a host says rather than a thing a layer assumes. A puts the settings service on that answer with zero private defaults; B keeps a private default and names it 「the registry was not visible」; C answers the question by refusing to ask it.
- **② Measured business pull.** In-repo production hosts: none (the plugin binds a source). The affected class is documented (`index.ts:78`: control-plane mocks, embedded runtimes) and today, on a `sys_organization` store, its NULL write fails at the driver's NOT NULL or duplicates on a nullable table — the #25226 defect with one more door. Pull is the correctness of a named host class, not a user report; p3 stays.
- **③ AI-error prevention.** An agent that wires `SettingsService` itself gets the derived organization without knowing D9 exists. An agent that wires a lean composition and forgets the declaration meets, on its first tenant write, the sentence that names the organization it did not supply — not a NULL row a ceremony reports months later (B), and not a boot refusal on a host that only ever reads global keys (C).
- **④ Startup no-sprawl.** No new input, no new gate, no staged window; the migration is one line per host and lives inside the package's own tests here.

Only-① pick: A. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Effort for the chosen letter: **M**, one PR, `effort: high` (p3, `domain:services`).

os-decision-facets
① 长远:A 让 settings 服务用 D9 自己的谓词、经它持有的 engine 问一次「无组织的调用者属于哪个组织」,服务不再私藏默认值;lean 组合是宿主声明的事,不是某一层假定的事。B 把「看不见 registry」写成第三个默认分支;C 用拒绝绑定来回避提问。
② 拉动:仓内生产宿主零受影响(插件恒绑来源);受影响的是 index.ts 点名的自绑定宿主类(控制面 mock、嵌入运行时),它们今天在 sys_organization 存储上写 NULL 行会撞 NOT NULL 或重复插入,即 #25226 同一缺陷的另一扇门;p3 不变。
③ 防错:自己接线的 agent 不知道 D9 也能拿到推导出的组织;忘记声明 lean 的 agent 在第一次 tenant 写入就被点名拒绝,而不是留下一行几个月后才被 ceremony 报出的 NULL 行(B),也不是在只读 global 键的宿主上启动即拒(C)。
④ 不扩散:不加输入、不加门禁、不设过渡窗;迁移每个宿主一行,仓内只在本包测试里。
Prior rulings read: sys_organization,organization-less,derivable,embedding,no-organization-object → 5 hits; ADR-0069 D3, ADR-0069 D5, ADR-0131 D9 (ADR-0069's two are MFA and network gating — read, not on point); thread: none; other cards: `6343868210` / `6344522520` (PR #25226), `6328987873` (#25133), `6345869077` (#25095); repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

- The card thread continues under its claim `6354964172`, same branch `claude/project-thread-c4vx2u`, same session; its next comment on this card carries `Ruling-ref: ` plus this comment's id at line start (no re-claim: the claim's route, surface and `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` stand). ⛔ Ruling is not dispatching; the thread already holds its slot.
- One PR, `domain:services` owns it, file surface as the claim names it: `settings-service.ts`, the service-settings tests of item 4, `index.ts`'s host paragraph, one `.changeset/*.md`. Title `fix(service-settings)!: …`. Review and landing per item 8.
- Serial constraints as the claim records them (none open on the file).
